title: Calculus intuition
targetPerformance: By hour 20, solve at least 16 of 20 fresh rate, derivative, optimization, and accumulation questions in 45 minutes; justify units and signs, and implement a derivative estimator and an area accumulator that pass their assertions.
whyItMatters: Use local change and accumulated totals to reason about motion, flow, and best-case choices.

subskills.title: Rates of change
subskills.why: Read slope as change per unit input.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check output units divided by input units.

subskills.title: Limits by numbers
subskills.why: Separate a nearby trend from the value at a hole.
subskills.selfCorrection: Approach from both sides and never divide by zero.

subskills.title: Slope under a microscope
subskills.why: See a curve as locally straight.
subskills.selfCorrection: Halve the step and compare the estimated slope.
drills: Compare a tangent and a secant.

subskills.title: Power rule
subskills.selfCorrection: Check a derivative at zero and at one.

subskills.title: Product and chain rules
subskills.why: Track two changing factors and nested changes.
subskills.selfCorrection: Keep both product terms and the inner derivative.

subskills.title: Optimization
subskills.why: Turn a maximum into a sign change.
subskills.selfCorrection: Check endpoints and whether slope changes positive to negative.

subskills.title: Accumulated area
subskills.selfCorrection: Check rectangle bounds and signed area.

subskills.title: Fundamental theorem
subskills.why: Connect accumulation back to instantaneous rate.
subskills.selfCorrection: Differentiate an accumulated total to recover its rate.
drills: Differentiate an integral with moving upper bound.

resources.title: 3Blue1Brown — Essence of calculus
resources.why: Visual lessons on local change and accumulation; watch one chapter after attempting its challenges.

resources.title: Khan Academy — Calculus 1
resources.why: Short videos and instantly checked exercises for limits, derivatives, and rules.

resources.title: OpenStax — Calculus Volume 1
resources.why: Free textbook with worked examples and odd-numbered answers for self-correction.

resources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare — 18.01SC Single Variable Calculus
resources.why: Problem sets with full solutions for optimization and the fundamental theorem.

barriers.fix: Attempt one prompt before consulting one short resource section.
Sketch or describe the quantities, predict sign and scale, then compute.
Record the failed assumption, use the next hint, and retry with changed numbers.
